description: This file defines a Catalyst controller class for managing tags and tag groups within a project. It includes methods for listing, creating, editing, updating, and deleting tags and tag groups, as well as generating submenu items for navigation.

classes.name: Coocook::Controller::Tag
classes.description: Catalyst controller class for managing tags and tag groups within a project.

methods.name: sub submenu
methods.description: Generates submenu items for tag management navigation.

methods.name: sub index
methods.description: Lists tags and tag groups for the current project.

methods.name: sub new_tag
methods.description: Prepares data for creating a new tag.

methods.name: sub new_tag_group
methods.description: Prepares data for creating a new tag group.

methods.name: sub tag
methods.description: Fetches a specific tag by ID for viewing or editing.

methods.name: sub tag_group
methods.description: Fetches a specific tag group by ID for viewing or editing.

methods.name: sub edit
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a specific tag.

methods.name: sub edit_group
methods.description: Prepares data for editing a specific tag group.

methods.name: sub create
methods.description: Creates a new tag associated with a project and optional group.

methods.name: sub update
methods.description: Updates an existing tag with new data.
